name: audit
description: Three-agent read-only audit with independent review angles and compact synthesis.

parallel.label: Correctness and runtime
parallel.task:
Audit this target for correctness and runtime defects: {task}

Inspect repository instructions, the relevant diff, source, callers, tests, configuration, and error/cleanup/concurrency paths. Scope and refine broad or truncated searches. Trace every changed cross-boundary value through its real consumer or dispatcher, including code outside the diff, and check the owning test. If a pi-workbench-feature-ledger is referenced, open it and the sources named by its Spec baseline, then check the named stable task, milestone, or review gate for specification traceability, acceptance, correctness, integration, and runtime behavior. Verify that work-plan status, Evidence, and Handoff match reality. Where applicable, verify compatibility, migrations, deployment or ordering assumptions, rollback, cleanup, and failure recovery. Report only actionable defects introduced or exposed by this scope and tied to the governing contract; reject unrelated issues, speculation, preferences, optional hardening, and duplicate symptoms. Do not edit files. Finish with the required structured envelope: READY requires no findings; NOT_READY requires one or more findings. Keep evidence and residual risks compact, and include ledgerDisposition only for a named work-plan gate.

parallel.label: Tests, simplicity, and applicable security
parallel.task:
Independently audit this target for tests, simplicity, and applicable security: {task}

Look for missing regression or characterization coverage, unnecessary complexity, brittle integration seams, and security issues only where the change exposes a real trust boundary. Scope and refine broad or truncated searches. Trace changed cross-boundary values through their real consumers or dispatchers and check owning tests. If a pi-workbench-feature-ledger is referenced, open it and the sources named by its Spec baseline, then check the named stable task, milestone, or review gate for acceptance coverage, tests, simplicity, maintainability, and applicable security. Verify that work-plan status, Evidence, and Handoff match reality. Inspect the actual diff, source, tests, documentation, changelog or migration notes, configuration, and operational checks where release scope requires them. Report only actionable defects or material validation gaps introduced or exposed by this scope and tied to the governing contract; reject unrelated issues, speculation, preferences, optional hardening, and duplicate symptoms. Do not edit files. Finish with the required structured envelope: READY requires no findings; NOT_READY requires one or more findings. Keep evidence and residual risks compact, and include ledgerDisposition only for a named work-plan gate.
